A program running in a phux terminal wants to control another app. phux does not control other apps itself.
A program running in a phux terminal wants to record system audio. phux does not record audio itself.

A program running in a phux terminal wants to read your contacts. phux does not read your contacts itself.
A program running in a phux terminal wants to find and connect to devices on your local network. phux itself uses the network only for the remote connections you set up.
A program running in a phux terminal wants to use your location. phux does not use your location itself.
A program running in a phux terminal wants to use your microphone. phux does not use the microphone itself.
